title: US court rules many of Trump's global tariffs are illegal
summary: The tariffs can remain in place until mid-October to allow the Trump administration time to request the Supreme Court take up the case.

title: Many of Trump’s Punishing Tariffs Are Illegal, Appeals Court Rules
summary: The decision is a big blow to President Trump’s trade policies, but the judges left the duties in place for now to allow time for a likely appeal to the Supreme Court.

title: US appeals court rules Trump’s foreign tariff campaign is largely illegal
summary: But the court has allowed the tariffs to remain in place while the Trump administration appeals to the Supreme Court.

title: Trump’s Global Tariffs Found Illegal by US Appeals Court
summary: Most of President Donald Trump’s global tariffs were ruled illegal by a federal appeals court that found he exceeded his authority in imposing them, but the judges let the levies stay in place while the case is subject to further review.
